description: This course covers core Artificial Intelligence methodologies while emphasising design, integration, and independent inquiry. Students will study search, constraint satisfaction, adversarial reasoning, logical representations, automated planning, and sequential decision‑making using Markov Decision Processes. Students are expected to design and extend AI solutions, explore alternative representations, and critically investigate open‑ended problem settings with a substantial project component within the context of responsible use of AI.
